newsitem.title: USA: Gliatech ADCON-L to get expedited review.
newsitem.headline: Gliatech ADCON-L to get expedited review.

text.p: Gliatech Inc said Tuesday its premarket approval application, which was accepted for filing in February by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for ADCON-L, will receive expedited review.

The FDA has determined ADCON-L may provide a public health benefit by acting as a barrier to epidural adhesion formation after lumbar discectomy. There are about 400,000 related procedures performed annually in the United States.
ADCON-L is the first product available to prevent undesirable scarring and adhesions following lumbar surgery, Gliatech said.
